subject: CAIQ control partitioning and sampling cadence — CloudBank evidence sprint
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cloudbank.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBank Audit Team <audit@cloudbank.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control partitioning and sampling cadence — CloudBank evidence sprint

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. CloudBank's external audit team has requested a CAIQ submission plus a set of sampled artifacts for a subset of controls. To keep the handoff tight we've proposed that Redwood partition the CAIQ controls into three sampling buckets:

- Config/Config-management docs (policy PDFs, change logs)
- Runtime telemetry (inference traces, KV cache access logs, request/response samples)
- Administrative proofs (user provisioning, key rotation logs, attestation statements)

We'd like to receive:
1) a simple control->bucket mapping (CSV or spreadsheet),
2) a list of specific artifacts you'll supply for each sampled control, and
3) a proposed sampling cadence and attestation window.

Target timeline from our side: initial samples by Aug 25, final attestation (DocuSign) by Sep 2, and upload to the shared Drive link (please let me know if you need a different mechanism).

Could you confirm owners for each bucket and whether you can meet the Aug 25 initial delivery? If any controls are out-of-scope for CloudBank (data residency reasons), flag them and we can exclude.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Zhang
Security Manager, CloudBank
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cloudbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control partitioning and sampling cadence — CloudBank evidence sprint

Emily —

Acknowledged. We'll run a focused sprint to produce the mapping and the initial artifact bundle. Proposed internal owners and scope:

- Config/docs: Marissa Cole (policy, access matrices, change logs, DocuSign-ready PDFs)
- Runtime telemetry & logs: Kimberly Park (request traces, KV cache samples, inference telemetry slices — redacted as needed)
- Admin proofs & attestations: Priya (key rotation logs, IAM snapshots, attestation statement)

Sampling cadence I propose (flexible if you need shifts):
- Week of Aug 24: initial pull (one-week window of artifacts where applicable)
- Week of Sep 7: second pull for cross-checking and any auditor follow-ups

Kimberly — can you confirm the exact log slices you can provide by Aug 25 and whether we should be pulling from prod or the prod-retention replica? Marissa — I'll need the DocuSign-ready PDFs by Aug 27 so we can hit the Sep 2 attestation window.

I'll compile the control->bucket mapping spreadsheet and share in the Drive folder (and will attach the matrix here once it's ready).

Priya Natarajan
Head of Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cloudbank.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control partitioning and sampling cadence — CloudBank evidence sprint

Priya / Emily —

I've sketched a quick partition matrix and included the artifact list in the attached spreadsheet (caiq-partition-matrix.xlsx). Highlights:

- Runtime telemetry (Controls: INF-2, LOG-6, ISV-3): we can pull:
  * 48-hour request trace (sampled, PII redacted)
  * KV cache hit/miss logs for the same window
  * CPU/GPU inference metrics for top 10 model instances

- Config/docs (Controls: CFG-1, CFG-4):
  * Current policy PDFs (access_control.pdf, key_mgmt_policy.pdf)
  * Change history export (CSV) for config repo for last 90 days

- Admin proofs (Controls: IAM-1, KMS-2):
  * IAM snapshot (users/groups/roles) as of Aug 1
  * KMS rotation logs (timestamps + signer IDs)

Notes/asks:
- For runtime traces I recommend pulling from the prod-retention replica (sanitized) — that avoids sensitive live-console access and matches auditors' expectancy.
- All telemetry artifacts will have a README.txt describing sampling method and redaction rules.
- I can deliver the runtime artifacts (small sample bundle) by Aug 25 if we scope to a 48-hour window. Full evidence set for controls in the matrix will follow in the second pull week (Sep 7).

Attachments: caiq-partition-matrix.xlsx (matrix + artifact manifest)
DocuSign link (for attestation): DocuSign: DS-98765

Kimberly Park
Director, Runtime Security & Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cloudbank.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control partitioning and sampling cadence — CloudBank evidence sprint

All —

Confirming:
- I'll prepare the config/doc PDFs and the change-history CSV and upload them to the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example) by EOD Aug 26.
- I'll generate the DocuSign-ready attestation packet (redwood-csa-attestation.docx) and send for signature by Aug 27 so we can hit the Sep 2 deadline.
- Kimberly: I'll coordinate with your team for the README.txt that explains redaction and sampling. Once you drop the sample-logs.zip in the Drive I'll run a quick QA to ensure trace IDs and timestamps are intact for auditor referencing.

Next steps (short checklist):
- [ ] Priya: share final control->bucket mapping in Drive (matrix + quick narrative) — by Aug 20 COB — done?
- [x] Kimberly: runtime sample capability and matrix (attached) — will deliver initial bundle Aug 25
- [ ] Marissa: upload docs + attestation packet — by Aug 26/27
- [ ] Emily/Audit: confirm whether the prod-retention replica is acceptable as evidence source (flag any exclusions)

Thanks — we should be able to meet CloudBank's window with this plan.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
